reasoning_content: As a result of the tool's Podman session disconnection, `just serve` (and all three dev server node processes that were child processes of it) got forcibly killed, and the dev ports have disappeared. The infrastructure (docker containers, including the proxy, backend, and database) is still healthy. I'll restart `just serve` (the store is warmed up, so the build will be fast) and then re-verify.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export GITHUB_TOKEN="urbo-dev-token-not-consumed-by-build" && nohup just serve > /tmp/just-serve3.log 2>&1 &
echo "serve3 pid $!"; sleep 60; grep -aE "Building|Local:|crashed|exited" /tmp/just-serve3.log | tail -5; pgrep -f "[s]erve.mjs" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo STOPPED

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && export GITHUB_TOKEN=\"urbo-dev-token-not-consumed-by-build\" && nohup just serve > /tmp/just-serve3.log 2>&1 &\necho \"serve3 pid $!\"; sleep 60; grep -aE \"Building|Local:|crashed|exited\" /tmp/just-serve3.log | tail -5; pgrep -f \"[s]erve.mjs\" >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo STOPPED", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Restart just serve after outage"}
